title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Transfer Fee Clause
content:
**Clause.** The standard transfer fee under Warranty Coverage is the plan's transfer fee, charged once to the seller on the request date. A fee is charged only when a submitted transfer request naming the buyer is on file for the registration; with none on file nothing is charged.

**Amount.** The request timing sets the timed fee from the plan's transfer fee; the timed fee is multiplied by the size rate, then by the member rate, then by the remaining-term share; and the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, an amount exactly halfway between two cents going to the higher cent. The timed fee is the plan's transfer fee, and the size rate, the member rate and the remaining-term share are one.

The plan's transfer fee is the figure of the plan's transfer schedule. The request date is the date the seller confirms the request.

## Request on file and fee

| Submitted transfer request naming the buyer on file for the registration | Fee |
|---|---|
| yes | charged once, on the request date |
| no | nothing is charged |

## Worked figures (hypothetical plan transfer fee 80.00)

1. A submitted request naming the buyer is on file: the timed fee 80.00, multiplied by one, one and one, is 80.00, charged once to the seller on the request date.
2. No submitted request is on file for the registration: nothing is charged.

## Rounding

The fee is rounded once, after the last multiplication, to the cent.
